player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I included the word "trade" in my explanation, which implies a market exchange concept too close to the forbidden words "economy," "demand," and "supply." I also did not explicitly emphasize that time is a non-renewable resource that cannot be bought back, which is the core of the "buying" metaphor. Next time, I will strictly avoid any words suggesting a market system. Instead, I will focus entirely on the physical effort and the irreversible nature of time. I will rephrase the conclusion to state clearly that time is a finite resource that must be spent to earn money, using the farmer's example to show that without spending time, no money is generated, without using the word "trade."
